GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide (6L from lead). Back 1 length to rear 3 Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & gave ground in last 200m. # Never in it.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied when buffeted heavily between runners shortly after the start. Approaching the 1000m was steadied and shifted out abruptly when awkwardly placed on heels. Raced three wide, without cover, from this point. Apprentice dropped her whip near the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.25 Lengths 2-3 wide, out 3 Wide from 1050m, Moved Up Two Wide Outside Lead at 800m, drew clear at 600m, led a half length turning, got away rounding turn, kept going in Straight # just lasted to win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, to the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down on fence trailing a head, railed to joint Lead at 1100m, edged clear by the 1000m, Held Together in front & led rail by a head turning, stayed to the rail turning and in straight, Headed 200m and Lost Ground in the run home # weakened in str.

Away fairly. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & tried to sprint with winner @ 200m. No match late. # On-pace/no match
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 10 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 8 Lengths Two Wide (4 leader) turning, shifted Four Wide Straightening Up and ran up to hit Lead centre of track at the 200m, only Headed in the shadows of the post # slow out/ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow and awkward to begin. Laid out under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok ? nbsd 4th 1x1 3 Lengths and Outside winner, let stride = Lead 3 Wide x 400m into Lead Soon After Straightening Up Collared x 150m and Couldn'T Go On had its chance - was # no match at all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and then raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 3rd last 6 Lengths 1000m 8th fence over-racing fence 8 Lengths home turn 8th fence Under Pressure 7 Lengths rails run Straight to only hold position # one paced run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier, was shifted in behind runners. Over-raced during the early and middle stages and hung out throughout the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field rails 6 Lengths 600m, stayed back inside but just battled at the one pace # one paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered and carried inwards approaching the 900m. Bumped rounding the home turn. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Jumped well. Rolled fwd before Settled Down behind leader on inside (2L from lead). Tracked leader on inside midrace & held up Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along Four Wide @ 200m & looked a chance @ 100m but unable to be ridden out late. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels. Steadied to avoid heels near the 100m. Not tested over the concluding stages when held up for clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd to lead narrowly on inside early . Shared lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken but headed on home turn. Gave ground on inside in straight. Rider - didn't appreciate pressure up front. Vetted clear. # On-pace/weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the mare rider stated that he endeavoured to lead the small field and dictate terms. Rider stated that whilst he was able to establish the lead his mount was constantly challenged by another runner in the early and middle stages. Rider stated his mount did not appear to appreciate this pressure and was disappointing in the manner it sprinted down the straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.
